name: Crystal
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Next-generation algorithmic reverb built on the Dattorro allpass-loop topology (the lineage behind Lexicon / EMT / Crystalline). Modulated delays for a chorused tail, in-loop +12-semitone shimmer for angelic halos, dual-band damping for natural decay, sidechain ducker, freeze, gate, and a tilt EQ. Pass it a vocal and you get the synthetic-but-musical space pop / electronic production needs.
